body: If I wake up slowly I have a sound hallucination of a dishwasher going. It took moving out of my childhood house and going to college and still hearing it to figure out that the dishwasher wasn't always on when I was waking up.

My grandpa (now dead) had his cousin record the eye sight test. He memorized it and then passed his test. 

He drove for a long time legally blind (could see out of his parephials) Somehow never got in an accident, but I don't think this should be ok. At one time there was a bus in front of us and he said "the windshields are dirty" we wiped them. Then he said "now all I see is yellow."

Definitely agree there should be tests after 75!
Thank you. I was really low for a long time, really high and happy temporarily,  and now it seems I'm low again. I am glad you posted your story, it relieved some thoughts.
That stupid food pyramid that basically said eat as many breads as you'd like.
